description.value: Via Tevere is an award-winning Vera Pizza Napoletana-certified restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, recognized by Vancouver Magazine and Georgia Straight for best pizza on the East Side. Authentic wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas are the centrepiece, alongside antipasti, pasta, and house-made gnocchi. The restaurant also operates a second brick-and-mortar location on Victoria Drive and a food truck, making it a well-established local institution on a popular urban cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and corroborates the OSM address (3240 Main St, Vancouver, BC V5V 3M5) and phone (604-876-5408). The menu pages confirm takeout/pickup/delivery options and gluten-free items, and OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=only are partially supported by the website (vegan/vegetarian options exist, plus a 'plant based version available' note), but diet:vegetarian=only is contradicted by extensive meat items on the menu — flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM tag diet:vegetarian=only is incorrect — the full menu contains numerous meat-based items (prosciutto, salame, anchovies, pancetta, etc.). This tag should be corrected in OSM.
No bike parking, bike rack, or bike visibility information found anywhere on the website; this required criterion is unresolvable from available evidence alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Strong candidate on a busy cycling corridor with takeout, vegetarian/vegan/GF options, and a well-maintained website, but no evidence of bike parking or racks was found — the minimum WWC required criterion of bike parking or visibility cannot be confirmed and may require a site visit or outreach to the business.
